cmdRun.message: Run a fiddle and exit with its exit code

cmdBisect.message: Run a fiddle on each version between a good and a bad one to find where it breaks

cmdGistPublish.message: Publish a fiddle folder as a new gist

cmdGistUpdate.message: Replace a gist's files with a fiddle folder's

cmdExport.message: Save a fiddle to a folder

cmdPackage.message: Package a fiddle with Electron Forge

cmdMake.message: Make installers for a fiddle with Electron Forge

argFiddle.message: A folder, a gist ID or URL, example:<name> or electron:<tag>/<path>
argFiddle.description: CLI help for the <fiddle> argument. Keep example:<name> and electron:<tag>/<path> as they are.

argVersion.description: CLI help for a version argument or --version.

argElectronPath.message: A local Electron build: its folder or its executable

argEnv.message: An environment variable for the fiddle, as KEY=value
argEnv.description: CLI help for --env. Keep KEY=value as it is.

argModule.message: An npm package for the fiddle, as name@version
argModule.description: CLI help for --module. Keep name@version as it is.

argPm.message: The package manager to install packages with

argTrust.message: Let a remote fiddle's code run without asking. Its packages still install without install scripts.

argGood.message: A version where the fiddle works

argBad.message: A later version where the fiddle fails

argChannel.message: A release channel: stable, beta or nightly
argChannel.description: CLI help for --channel. Keep stable, beta and nightly as they are.

argObsolete.message: Include versions older than the supported ones

argId.description: CLI help for a gist <id> argument.

argRevision.message: A revision SHA of the gist

argPublic.message: Make the gist public instead of secret

argForge.message: Save as an Electron Forge project

argJson.message: Print JSON lines with a schemaVersion
argJson.description: CLI help for --json. Keep schemaVersion as it is.

helpUsage.description: CLI help's first line. {{usage}} is the command syntax.

helpCommands.description: CLI help heading above the command list.

helpArguments.description: CLI help heading above a command's arguments.

helpOptions.description: CLI help heading above a command's options.

helpMore.message: Add --help after a command to see its options.
helpMore.description: Last line of the CLI's command list.

helpRepeatable.description: Appended to the help of an option that can be given more than once.

helpDefault.description: Appended to an option's help. {{value}} is the default value.

errorPrefix.description: How the CLI prints an error. {{message}} is the error text.

errorHelpHint.message: Run it with --help to see its options.
errorHelpHint.description: Printed after a mistake in the command line.

errorUnknownCommand.description: CLI error for an unknown command.

errorUnknownOption.description: CLI error for an unknown option. {{option}} is the option as typed, such as --forge; {{command}} is the command it was given to.

errorMissingValue.description: CLI error: an option was given without its value.

errorUnexpectedValue.description: CLI error: a switch was given a value. {{option}} is the switch as typed, such as --json.

errorTooManyArguments.description: CLI error: extra positional arguments. {{args}} is the extra arguments, separated by spaces.

errorMissingArgument.description: CLI error: a required argument or option is missing. {{name}} is e.g. <fiddle> or --out.

errorInvalidChoice.description: CLI error: a value isn't one of the allowed ones. {{name}} is the option or argument, {{choices}} the allowed values separated by commas.

errorInvalidValue.description: CLI error: a value failed validation. {{name}} is the option or argument, {{message}} says what is wrong with it.

invalidVersion.description: The end of the CLI error 'X is invalid: …' when a version option or argument isn't a version. Lower case: it follows a colon. Keep 30.0.0 as it is.

errorFiddleNotFound.message: “{{fiddle}}” isn't a folder, a gist ID or URL, example:<name> or electron:<tag>/<path>.
errorFiddleNotFound.description: CLI error when the <fiddle> argument can't be resolved.

errorUnknownExample.message: There's no example named “{{name}}”. The examples are: {{names}}
errorUnknownExample.description: CLI error for example:<name> with an unknown name. {{name}} is the name given, {{names}} the available examples.

errorElectronExample.message: Write Electron's examples as electron:<tag>/<path>, e.g. electron:v30.0.0/docs/fiddles/quick-start.
errorElectronExample.description: CLI error for a malformed electron: fiddle.

errorInvalidModule.description: CLI error for a bad --module value.

errorElectronPathMissing.description: CLI error when --electron-path has no Electron binary.

errorGistId.message: “{{id}}” isn't a gist ID or URL.
errorGistId.description: CLI error for a bad gist argument. {{id}} is the text given.

errorNoToken.message: Set GITHUB_TOKEN to a GitHub token with the gist scope.
errorNoToken.description: CLI error when a gist command needs a token. Keep GITHUB_TOKEN as it is.

errorUntrusted.message: This fiddle comes from {{origin}}. Add --trust to let its code run.
errorUntrusted.description: CLI error when a remote fiddle would run without --trust and there's no terminal to ask in. {{origin}} is where the fiddle comes from, such as a gist URL.

trustQuestion.description: CLI prompt before a remote fiddle's code runs; a space is added after it. Only y or yes continues, so keep [y/N].

warnInvalidPackageJson.message: The fiddle's package.json isn't valid JSON, so it was ignored.
warnInvalidPackageJson.description: CLI warning while loading a fiddle.

warnUnusableVersion.message: Electron {{version}} from the fiddle's package.json can't be used here.
warnUnusableVersion.description: CLI warning while loading a fiddle. {{version}} is the Electron version named in the fiddle's package.json.

warnRejectedModules.description: CLI warning while loading a fiddle. {{modules}} is a comma-separated list.

warnGistPartial.message: Created {{url}} from the template, but adding the fiddle's files failed. Run gist update to finish.
warnGistPartial.description: CLI warning when a publish half-succeeds. {{url}} is the new gist's URL. Keep “gist update” as it is.

stateInstalled.description: CLI versions list: the version is downloaded.

stateObsolete.description: CLI versions list: the version is older than the supported ones.

resultNoVersions.description: CLI versions list with no rows.

resultDownloaded.description: CLI result of versions download. {{version}} is the Electron version, {{path}} the path of its executable.

resultGistPublished.description: CLI result of gist publish. {{url}} is the new gist's URL.

resultGistUpdated.description: CLI result of gist update. {{url}} is the gist's URL.

resultGistDeleted.description: CLI result of gist delete. {{id}} is the gist ID.

resultRevisionCreated.description: CLI gist history: the first revision.

resultRevisionN.description: CLI gist history: a later revision.

resultExported.description: CLI result of export. {{name}} is the fiddle's name, {{dir}} the folder it was saved to.
